title: Confidence-Calibrated Inference Expansion for Evaluator-Guided Test-Time Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20836v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluator-guided reasoning presents a local control problem at every step: trust the current answer, return a fallback, or spend more inference. We formulate this choice as a compute-aware three-action controller, scoring terminal actions by predicted answer success and expansion by a rollout-based continuation-success surrogate, with compute cost priced explicitly. A local action-gap analysis characterizes when score errors can change a decision, while an expected regret bound accounts for errors along the realized expansion path. Guided by this analysis, we learn and calibrate action-specific confidence estimates, with local uncertainty penalties for ambiguous decisions. On held-out width expansion and revision tasks, the controller improves observed utility over calibration-selected fixed policies while reducing normalized online compute by about 30% and 16%, respectively. translated_title: 面向评估器引导测试时推理的置信度校准推理扩展
translated_abstract: 评估器引导的推理在每一步都面临一个局部控制问题：信任当前答案、返回回退结果，还是投入更多推理计算。我们将这一选择形式化为一个计算感知的三动作控制器：通过预测答案成功度对终止动作进行评分，通过基于 rollout 的后续成功替代指标对扩展动作进行评分，并显式地为计算成本定价。局部动作间隔分析刻画了评分误差何时可能改变决策，而期望遗憾界则考虑了沿实际扩展路径出现的误差。在该分析的指导下，我们学习并校准动作特定的置信度估计，并对模糊决策引入局部不确定性惩罚。在留出的宽度扩展和修订任务上，该控制器相比校准选择的固定策略提升了观测效用，同时将归一化在线计算量分别降低约 30% 和 16%。在四个 Qwen3-8B 随机种子上，计算量低于拟合的 Q…
tldr: 提出一个计算感知的三动作控制器，通过学习并校准动作特定的置信度估计来决定测试时推理中何时扩展计算，在提升效用的同时将在线计算量降低约 30% 和 16%。
en_tdlr: A compute-aware three-action controller with learned and calibrated action-specific confidence estimates decides when to expand inference during test-time reasoning, improving utility while reducing online compute by about 30% and 16%.
